name: general-simulator-gui
displayName: General Simulator GUI for VS Code
description: Schematic capture, component authoring and circuit/system simulation inside VS Code, powered by the general-simulator engine.

generalSimulator.workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the general-simulator checkout (the directory containing pyproject.toml). Leave empty to auto-discover from the open workspace folders.
generalSimulator.workspaceRoot.markdownDescription: Folder holding the General Simulator Python checkout (the one with `pyproject.toml`) that the simulation kernel is started from. Empty uses the open workspace folders.

generalSimulator.pythonRunner.description: Command used to run the kernel sidecar. With the default 'uv', the sidecar is launched as `uv run --project <root> python -m kernel_sidecar`.
generalSimulator.pythonRunner.markdownDescription: Command used to start the Python simulation kernel — `uv` by default. Set to `python` or an absolute interpreter path if you manage the environment yourself.

generalSimulator.autoStartKernel.description: Start the kernel sidecar automatically when the extension activates.
generalSimulator.autoStartKernel.markdownDescription: Start the simulation kernel automatically when the extension activates.

generalSimulator.generalSimulatorPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the `general-simulator` binary — the engine that actually runs a simulation.

Leave empty to search, in order: this setting, `GENSIM_GENERAL_SIMULATOR_PATH`, then `PATH`, then a sibling `general-simulator` checkout beside the workspace. Build it with `cargo build --release -p general-simulator-cli` and point here at `target/release/general-simulator`.

generalSimulator.ngspicePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `ngspice` binary. Only needed for schematics run with the ngspice solver; the default engine does not use it. Empty searches `GENSIM_NGSPICE_PATH` then `PATH`.

generalSimulator.xycePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `Xyce` binary. Only needed for schematics run with the Xyce solver. Empty searches `GENSIM_XYCE_PATH` then `PATH`.

generalSimulator.octaveCliPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the `octave-cli` binary, for `octfunc` / `octblock` code blocks.

The engine looks this up on `PATH` only — it has no flag for it — so setting this puts its directory at the front of the `PATH` the simulation process inherits.

generalSimulator.pythonPath.markdownDescription:
Extra directories to put on `PYTHONPATH` for `pyblock` / `pyfunc` code blocks, so a block can import your own modules.

Relative entries resolve against the workspace folder. This does not change which interpreter runs — the engine embeds the one it was built against.

generalSimulator.environment.markdownDescription:
Extra environment variables for the simulation kernel and everything it starts.

An escape hatch for anything without its own setting. Applied after the settings above, so an entry here wins.
